benchmark.name: tFold (Nat. Commun. 2025)
benchmark.note: Aggregate screening/classification metrics; require 745-antibody panel (27 positives) + SAbDab-22-DesignAb dataset. H965 individual ipTM/PAE/DockQ are 'Not verified' in the benchmark.

comparison: NOT REPRODUCIBLE - published AUROC/enrichment/AAR require the original 745-antibody panel and SAbDab-22-DesignAb aggregate dataset (not provided); no published individual H965 ipTM exists to compare against.
observation: All 3 redesigned CDR-H3s have lower antibody-PD-1 pair-ipTM (0.28-0.49) than the H965 reference (0.72); the de novo redesign did not reproduce the H965 binding interface.
integrity: Did not fabricate AUROC/enrichment/AAR; did not assign paper's aggregate AUROC to a single candidate; did not infer binding from AUROC or AAR.
